title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Ravinia Festival | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Ravinia Festival, held at the Pavilion in Highland Park, Illinois, USA, on 3 August 2019.

It was the 14th show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019, and the first of two consecutive nights at the Ravinia Festival.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

Concert setlist

  • ‘Matchbox’
  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Evil Ways’ (Gregg Rolie)
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘Don’t Pass Me By’
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’

  • ‘Gypsy Queen’ (Gregg Rolie)
  • ‘You’re Sixteen’
  • ‘Anthem’
  • ‘Work To Do’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Oye Cómo Va’ (Gregg Rolie)
  • ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’
  • ‘Who Can It Be Now?’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
